text:
samira: Hotpatch branch (hotfix/allocator-leak) is ready for merge. CI mostly green but e2e flaky. We need two approvers before the 18:00 PT merge window or this misses today's cut. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5112
alex: looking now. quick skim — change is small, but I'll run unit tests locally. if they pass i'll review :thumbsup:
mike: pinged, i'll pick this up next. should be able to review in ~20m
ci-bot: CI pipeline summary: unit-tests ✅, lint ✅, integration tests: flaky (2/3). recommended action: rerun failing job
samira: note — if we merge before cutoff we want canary-1 at 10% traffic. @jordan can you confirm rollout config OK?
jordan: confirmed, canary config looks good. also prefer gating on smoke tests if e2e keeps flaking
alex: ran tests locally, hit one intermittent allocator test. left a comment on the PR with repro steps and a potential guard
mike: saw alex's comment, pushed a tiny null-check fix and updated the PR. requesting reviews from @alex and @jordan
alex: reviewed and left a small nits suggestion, but overall 👍 approved. added monitoring threshold note
jordan: approved. canary rollout settings validated. that's two approvers
samira: awesome — holding for one last CI rerun. will merge at 17:52 PT if green (gives us a short window to abort if something spikes)
deploy-bot: Merge job queued: hotfix/allocator-leak -> main at 2024-06-12T17:52:00-07:00
ci-bot: Re-run complete: all checks passed ✅ (unit, lint, smoke). integration flaky jobs now green
samira: merging now and enabling canary-1 (10%). monitoring on watch for 15m
alex: watching logs, no errors so far
mike: smoke checks passing in canary. will signal when it's safe to promote
samira: promoting to full rollout in 20m if no anomalies. thanks y'all :party_parrot:
